title: Where the backup warning lives — round 2: the tour stop and the top of Permissions

steps.path: Starts on its own after setup; again from Settings → Help & feedback → Show me around
steps.headline: The tour's new stop 6 of 9, right after Files, now built for real: your sentence, word for word.
steps.changed: The stop is now part of the tour for everyone who finishes setup (no practice switch). The Files tab stays ringed while the buddy says it.
steps.notice: The tour is one stop longer. Phone and browser users never get the tour; they see the Permissions notice instead, if they open it.

steps.headline: The backup warning now sits at the top of the Permission modes card, always shown.
steps.changed: Your sentence in the notice box, above Ask first, in the card's own text size. No button: this card only explains.
steps.notice: The card is about two lines taller; Always allowed moves down. The same words as the tour stop, from one place, so they can't drift apart.
